G-CLOSING-DRY-STEP.reads: the gate`s record: the closing run dry before the lock, its head line, citation line, the reading, the bridge, the widening, the Epstein plan, the dispatches and kernels sections and the defects row printed (b675 rules row 1)

G-CITATION-CHECKED.reads: the citation check`s bank (the gate step at step zero): every cite checked, the two misses the ruling`s and each raised as a prompt before Component 2, its bank written before the step-zero banks` commit and that commit before Component 1

G-ROWGEN-STEPZERO.reads: the rowgen bank: constellation and the build-free diff over the 19 roster tables, both exit 0 (b670 rules row 3)

G-BRANCHES-BANKED.reads: the branches banks: every tip banked before the first delete (b695 (a)), then the five rows through the record tool`s reader, each merged, local, deleted

G-DELETES-ONE-BRANCH.reads: the command capture by the record tool`s reader and the command bank: each branch delete naming one branch, no glob and no variable in any half, nothing chained after (data/b694_rules.txt row (1)), the ruling`s five exactly

G-ANSWERS-CHECKED.reads: the citation bank`s mid-act prints read at HEAD, each before the step its answer governs (the branches` first commits)

G-SCORER-READS-BANKS.reads: tools/b701_record.py`s code, prose stripped: the N1-N4 scorers reading banks and commits and no ledger, the scores bank written once, the entry`s scores line from it

G-ENTRY-SCORES-EQUAL.reads: FINDINGS at the findings bank`s line and the scores bank: the entry`s scores line equal to the line composed from the bank

G-ENTRY-TITLE-FORM.reads: FINDINGS at the findings bank`s line and the record tool`s title from the banks: the ferry`s form, titled by its objects, adjusted to what the act did

G-CORR-BEFORE-THEOREM.reads: the restatement`s reading bank and its json, and the bridge branch`s first commit: HOLDS-BY-CORRESPONDENCE at every binder and at binder 13, the controls behaving, the bank timed before the theorem was written (N2)

G-PLAN-BEFORE-LEAN.reads: the two plans` commits (each one file) and the widening branch`s first commit: the widening plan banked and raised before any Lean file for it exists (N2); the Epstein plan committed alone

G-DISPATCH-PER-BRANCH.reads: the dispatches bank, the runner rows through the record tool`s reader and the command bank: two at the most, SIDE-explicit-formula alone, one per tree at a branch tip of this act, each artifact`s sha256 read (N1)

G-PRINTS-STD3.reads: the axioms banks of this act`s runs: every new name printed at the standard three (N3)

G-GRADE-BEFORE-MERGE.reads: the grade banks` first commits against the merges` commit times, each statement verbatim with its grade, every salt-check passed, the hand reading and the E0 check agreeing (N3)

G-TAGS-READ-BACK.reads: one ls-remote of SIDE-explicit-formula in this part: v0.35 (and v0.36) peeled at the remote equal to the local merge, the remote main the local main (N4)

G-CLAUSE-DOMINANCE-REREAD.reads: the CLAUSE-DOMINANCE bank re-read after the merge: by correspondence 2 of 2 through the restatement, the tag and the run named ((R311)(2))

G-FACES-ROW-HELD.reads: the faces successor row drafted into relay data/b701_faces_rows.txt naming the bridge by tag, the page unedited (G-CURRENTS-UNEDITED), held for b702

G-WIDENING-OUTCOME.reads: the widening`s outcome by its banks: merged with its run DERIVES and its grade, or held with the obstruction banked (the goal verbatim, a trigger) and no v0.36, or not run on the word ((R311)(3), N4)

G-GLOSSARY-ROW-HELD.reads: relay data/glossary.txt before, now and at HEAD unedited; the classK’ row drafted into relay data/b701_glossary_rows.txt where the widening merged

G-EPSTEIN-PLAN-PRICED.reads: the Epstein plan bank and its commit: the opening step priced at 1 dispatch and the whole at 6 at the least, nothing compiled, committed alone ((R311)(4))

G-KERNEL-WRITES-NAMED.reads: SIDE-explicit-formula`s diff against the main before the act: the branches` new files and the print list alone, main moved by the merges (N5)

G-READFIRST-DIFF-BANKED.reads: the readfirst diff bank and the step-zero commit, and the hand list`s blob at HEAD against step zero`s: the diff banked, no bank rewritten

G-TOOL-REPAIRS.reads: the repairs bank`s verdict: the carry-time repairs, each by the defect or order it answers, no frozen bank edited

G-PARTS-PRERUN.reads: the pre-run bank`s six parts with their seconds, named in the form the parts arm reads

G-ARM-SECONDS-BANKED.reads: the per-arm seconds bank: every standing arm clocked at the pre-run, the three slowest named, each part`s seconds

G-DEFECTS-LETTERED.reads: the defects bank read at HEAD: the sealed letters its prefix, consecutive letters, owners the seat or the navigator

G-READ-RULE.reads: the read-call bank (data/b698_rules.txt row (2)) and the defects bank: every whole read of a file of two hundred lines or more entered by its transcript line

G-TRAIL-DEFECTS-EQUAL.reads: the gate`s record and OPEN_TRAILS from the trail`s head: the trail`s Defects line equal to the defects bank in the dry run and as landed
